//: The approved sha256 digest for every image this deployment pins. This is the single source of truth for what is APPROVED, separate from docker-compose.yml (what is actually RUNNING) - installation-scripts/validate-config.sh fails if the two disagree, and installation-scripts/check-digest-drift.sh fails if this disagrees with what the registry currently serves for the same tag. Update this file only when cutting a release (documentation/39-release-procedure.md) or after deliberately auditing drift reported by check-digest-drift.sh. Never hardcode a digest in a script - read this file instead.

nginx.why: Pinned to nginx's 'stable' release line, not 'latest'/'mainline'. 'latest' resolved to 1.31.6 (mainline) at the time this was pinned - mainline gets new features and is not the line nginx recommends for production. Re-pin to a newer 1.30.x stable release, not to mainline, when updating.
